tools.name: get_context_tree
tools.description: Get the structural tree of the project with file headers, function names, classes, enums, and line ranges. Automatically reads 2-line headers for file purpose. Dynamic token-aware pruning: Level 2 (deep symbols) -> Level 1 (headers only) -> Level 0 (file names only) based on project size.

target_path.description: Specific directory or file to analyze (relative to project root). Defaults to root.

depth_limit.description: How many folder levels deep to scan. Use 1-2 for large projects.

include_symbols.description: Include function/class/enum names in the tree. Defaults to true.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens for output. Auto-prunes if exceeded. Default: 20000.

tools.name: semantic_identifier_search
tools.description: Search semantic intent at identifier level (functions, methods, classes, variables) with definition lines and ranked call sites. Uses embeddings over symbol signatures and source context, then returns line-numbered definition/call chains.

query.description: Natural language intent to match identifiers and usages.

top_k.description: How many identifiers to return. Default: 5.

top_calls_per_identifier.description: How many ranked call sites per identifier. Default: 10.

semantic_weight.description: Weight for semantic similarity score. Default: 0.78.

keyword_weight.description: Weight for keyword overlap score. Default: 0.22.

tools.name: get_file_skeleton
tools.description: Get detailed function signatures, class methods, and type definitions of a specific file WITHOUT reading the full body. Shows the API surface: function names, parameters, return types, and line ranges. Perfect for understanding how to use code without loading it all.

file_path.description: Path to the file to inspect (relative to project root).

tools.name: semantic_code_search
tools.description: Search the codebase by MEANING, not just exact variable names. Uses Ollama embeddings over file headers and symbol names. Example: searching 'user authentication' finds files about login, sessions, JWT even if those exact words aren't used, with matched definition lines.

query.description: Natural language description of what you're looking for. Example: 'how are transactions signed'

top_k.description: Number of matches to return. Default: 5.

semantic_weight.description: Weight for embedding similarity in hybrid ranking. Default: 0.72.

keyword_weight.description: Weight for keyword overlap in hybrid ranking. Default: 0.28.

min_semantic_score.description: Minimum semantic score filter. Accepts 0-1 or 0-100.

min_keyword_score.description: Minimum keyword score filter. Accepts 0-1 or 0-100.

min_combined_score.description: Minimum final score filter. Accepts 0-1 or 0-100.

require_keyword_match.description: When true, only return files with keyword overlap.

require_semantic_match.description: When true, only return files with positive semantic similarity.

tools.name: get_blast_radius
tools.description: Before deleting or modifying code, check the BLAST RADIUS. Traces every file and line where a specific symbol (function, class, variable) is imported or used. Prevents orphaned code. Also warns if usage count is low (candidate for inlining).

symbol_name.description: The function, class, or variable name to trace across the codebase.

file_context.description: The file where the symbol is defined. Excludes the definition line from results.

tools.name: run_static_analysis
tools.description: Run the project's native linter/compiler to find unused variables, dead code, type errors, and syntax issues. Delegates detection to deterministic tools instead of LLM guessing. Supports TypeScript, Python, Rust, Go.

target_path.description: Specific file or folder to lint (relative to root). Omit for full project.

tools.name: propose_commit
tools.description: The ONLY way to write code. Validates the code against strict rules before saving: 2-line header comments, no inline comments, max nesting depth, max file length. Creates a shadow restore point before writing. REJECTS code that violates formatting rules.

file_path.description: Where to save the file (relative to project root).

new_content.description: The complete file content to save.

tools.name: list_restore_points
tools.description: List all shadow restore points created by propose_commit. Each point captures the file state before the AI made changes. Use this to find a restore point ID for undoing a bad change.

tools.name: undo_change
tools.description: Restore files to their state before a specific AI change. Uses the shadow restore point system. Does NOT affect git history. Call list_restore_points first to find the point ID.

point_id.description: The restore point ID (format: rp-timestamp-hash). Get from list_restore_points.

tools.name: semantic_navigate
tools.description: Browse the codebase by MEANING, not directory structure. Uses spectral clustering on Ollama embeddings to group semantically related files into labeled clusters. Inspired by Gabriella Gonzalez's semantic navigator. Requires Ollama running with an embedding model and a chat model for labeling.

max_depth.description: Maximum nesting depth of clusters. Default: 3.

tools.name: get_feature_hub
tools.description: Obsidian-style feature hub navigator. Hub files are .md files containing [[path/to/file]] wikilinks that act as a Map of Content. Modes: (1) No args = list all hubs, (2) hub_path or feature_name = show hub with bundled skeletons of all linked files, (3) show_orphans = find files not linked to any hub. Prevents orphaned code and enables graph-based codebase navigation.

hub_path.description: Path to a specific hub .md file (relative to root).

feature_name.description: Feature name to search for. Finds matching hub file automatically.

show_orphans.description: If true, lists all source files not linked to any feature hub.

tools.name: upsert_memory_node
tools.description: Create or update a memory node in the linking graph. Nodes represent concepts, files, symbols, or notes with auto-generated embeddings. If a node with the same label and type exists, it updates content and increments access count. Returns the node ID for use in create_relation.

type.description: Node type: concept (abstract ideas), file (source files), symbol (functions/classes), note (free-form).

label.description: Short identifier for the node. Used for deduplication with type.

content.description: Detailed content for the node. Used for embedding generation.

tools.name: create_relation
tools.description: Create a typed edge between two memory nodes. Supports relation types: relates_to, depends_on, implements, references, similar_to, contains. Edges have weights (0-1) that decay over time via e^(-λt). Duplicate edges update weight instead of creating new ones.

source_id.description: ID of the source memory node.

target_id.description: ID of the target memory node.

weight.description: Edge weight 0-1. Higher = stronger relationship. Default: 1.0.

metadata.description: Optional key-value metadata for the edge.

tools.name: search_memory_graph
tools.description: Search the memory graph by meaning with graph traversal. First finds direct matches via embedding similarity, then traverses 1st/2nd-degree neighbors to discover linked context. Returns both direct hits and graph-connected neighbors with relevance scores.

query.description: Natural language query to search the memory graph.

max_depth.description: How many hops to traverse from direct matches. Default: 1.

top_k.description: Number of direct matches to return. Default: 5.

edge_filter.description: Only traverse edges of these types. Omit for all types.

tools.name: prune_stale_links
tools.description: Remove stale memory graph edges whose weight has decayed below threshold via e^(-λt) formula. Also removes orphan nodes with no edges, low access count, and >7 days since last access. Keeps the graph lean.

threshold.description: Minimum decayed weight to keep an edge. Default: 0.15. Lower = keep more edges.

tools.name: add_interlinked_context
tools.description: Bulk-add multiple memory nodes with automatic similarity linking. Computes embeddings for all items, then creates similarity edges between any pair (new-to-new and new-to-existing) with cosine similarity ≥ 0.72. Ideal for importing related concepts, files, or notes at once.

items.description: Array of nodes to add. Each needs type, label, and content.

auto_link.description: Whether to auto-create similarity edges. Default: true.

tools.name: retrieve_with_traversal
tools.description: Start from a specific memory node and traverse the graph outward. Returns the starting node plus all reachable neighbors within the depth limit, scored by edge weight decay and depth penalty. Use after search_memory_graph to explore a specific node's neighborhood.

start_node_id.description: ID of the memory node to start traversal from.

max_depth.description: Maximum traversal depth from start node. Default: 2.

edge_filter.description: Only traverse edges of these types. Omit for all.
